# GroceryBudget - React Native App

**Project Type:** React Native + Expo with TypeScript  
**Status:** ✅ Scaffolding Complete - Ready for Development

## Checklist

- [x] Create project structure and dependencies
- [x] Initialize Expo project with TypeScript
- [x] Create all screen components (basic versions)
- [x] Set up navigation (bottom tabs + stack)
- [x] Implement state management (Zustand)
- [x] Build reusable UI components
- [x] Implement AsyncStorage persistence
- [x] Add utility functions (formatPeso, CSV export, voice parser)
- [x] Configure design system (colors, fonts, themes)
- [x] Install and verify dependencies
- [x] Verify project compiles without errors
- [x] Create initial documentation and README
- [x] Setup complete - ready for development

## Tech Stack
- React Native with Expo
- TypeScript (strict mode)
- React Navigation (bottom tabs + stack)
- Zustand for state management
- AsyncStorage for persistence
- expo-speech or @react-native-voice/voice for voice
- expo-camera for camera scanning
- expo-haptics for feedback
- expo-notifications for alerts
- Victory Native for charts
- expo-file-system + expo-sharing for export

## Currency
Philippine Peso (₱) only - hardcoded throughout

## Key Features
1. Create and manage shopping carts with budgets
2. Add items manually, by voice, or by camera scan
3. Track prices per store with history
4. Real-time budget tracking with visual progress bar
5. Spending recaps and insights
6. Cart templates (system + user-created)
7. Family sharing
8. CSV export
9. Offline-first with AsyncStorage
10. Guest mode (no login required)
